fusha_sentences.arabic: مرحبًا بكم في معهد ديوان.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Marhaban bikum fi ma'had Diwan.
fusha_sentences.english: Welcome to Deewan Institute.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قال المعلم مرحبًا لطلابه كل صباح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qala al-mu'allim marhaban li-tullabihi kull sabah.
fusha_sentences.english: The teacher said hello to his students every morning.

levantine_sentences.arabic: مرحبا، كيفك اليوم؟
levantine_sentences.english: Hello, how are you today?

levantine_sentences.arabic: مرحبا فيك ببيتنا!
levantine_sentences.english: Welcome to our home!

fusha_sentences.arabic: شكرًا جزيلًا على مساعدتك.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Shukran jazilan 'ala musa'adatik.
fusha_sentences.english: Thank you very much for your help.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قدّمت لها الهدية وقالت شكرًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qaddama laha al-hadiyya wa qalat shukran.
fusha_sentences.english: He gave her the gift and she said thank you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شكراً كتير، ما قصّرت!
levantine_sentences.english: Thank you so much, you didn't fall short!

levantine_sentences.arabic: يسلمو إيدك على الأكل الحلو.
levantine_sentences.english: Bless your hands for the delicious food.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الماء أساس الحياة على الأرض.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-ma' asas al-hayah 'ala al-ard.
fusha_sentences.english: Water is the foundation of life on earth.

fusha_sentences.arabic: شرب الطفل الماء بعد اللعب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Shariba al-tifl al-ma' ba'da al-la'ib.
fusha_sentences.english: The child drank water after playing.

levantine_sentences.arabic: جيبلي مي بارد من الثلاجة.
levantine_sentences.english: Bring me cold water from the fridge.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عطشان كتير، في ماي هون؟
levantine_sentences.english: I'm very thirsty, is there water here?

fusha_sentences.arabic: المنزل الجديد قريب من المدرسة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-manzil al-jadid qarib min al-madrasa.
fusha_sentences.english: The new house is close to the school.

fusha_sentences.arabic: بنى الرجل منزله بجهد كبير.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Bana al-rajul manzilahu bi-jahd kabir.
fusha_sentences.english: The man built his house with great effort.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البيت تبعنا كبير وفيه حديقة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-beit taba'na kbir w fih hadeeqe.
levantine_sentences.english: Our house is big and has a garden.

levantine_sentences.arabic: رجعت على البيت متأخر إمبارح.
levantine_sentences.english: I came back home late yesterday.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الطعام الصحي يقوّي الجسم والعقل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-ta'am al-sihhi yuqawwi al-jism wa al-'aql.
fusha_sentences.english: Healthy food strengthens the body and mind.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أعدّت الأم طعامًا شهيًا للعائلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: A'addat al-umm ta'aman shahiyan lil-'a'ila.
fusha_sentences.english: The mother prepared delicious food for the family.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل اليوم كان زاكي كتير!
levantine_sentences.english: The food today was very delicious!

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدي أكل، ما كلت من الصبح.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Biddi akol, ma kalt min il-subh.
levantine_sentences.english: I want to eat, I haven't eaten since morning.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الحبّ أقوى من كل شيء في الوجود.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-hubb aqwa min kull shay' fi al-wujud.
fusha_sentences.english: Love is stronger than everything in existence.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أعبّر عن حبّي لوطني بالعمل الجادّ.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: U'abbir 'an hubbi li-watani bil-'amal al-jadd.
fusha_sentences.english: I express my love for my country through hard work.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحب الحقيقي بيصبر وبيتحمل.
levantine_sentences.english: True love is patient and enduring.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحبك كتير وما رح تعرف قديش.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Bhibbak ktir w ma rah ta'rif adeesh.
levantine_sentences.english: I love you a lot and you'll never know how much.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العائلة هي ركيزة المجتمع الأساسية.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'a'ila hiya rakizat al-mujtama' al-asasiyya.
fusha_sentences.english: The family is the fundamental pillar of society.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يجتمع أفراد العائلة في عيد الفطر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yajtami' afrad al-'a'ila fi 'eid al-fitr.
fusha_sentences.english: Family members gather on Eid al-Fitr.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عيلتنا كبيرة وكلها ساكنة بعمان.
levantine_sentences.english: Our family is big and all living in Amman.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحب اجتماعات العيلة، بتعبّى القلب.
levantine_sentences.english: I love family gatherings, they fill the heart.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الصديق الحقيقي يقف بجانبك في الشدائد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-sadiq al-haqiqi yaqif bi-janibika fi al-shada'id.
fusha_sentences.english: A true friend stands by you in hardships.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تعرّفت على صديق جديد في الجامعة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ta'arraftu 'ala sadiq jadid fi al-jami'a.
fusha_sentences.english: I met a new friend at university.

levantine_sentences.arabic: صاحبي رح يجي يزورني بكرا.
levantine_sentences.english: My friend is coming to visit me tomorrow.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد رفيقي من أيام المدرسة.
levantine_sentences.english: This is my friend from school days.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العمل الجادّ يُحقّق الأحلام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'amal al-jadd yuhaqqiq al-ahlam.
fusha_sentences.english: Hard work achieves dreams.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يذهب إلى العمل كل يوم في الصباح الباكر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yadhabu ila al-'amal kull yawm fi al-sabah al-bakir.
fusha_sentences.english: He goes to work every day in the early morning.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الشغل كتير هالأيام، ما عندي وقت.
levantine_sentences.english: Work is a lot these days, I have no time.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لقيت شغل جديد بمرتب أحسن.
levantine_sentences.english: I found a new job with a better salary.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الكتاب خير جليس في الزمان.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-kitab khayr jalis fi al-zaman.
fusha_sentences.english: A book is the best companion in time.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قرأت هذا الكتاب في ثلاثة أيام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qara'tu hadha al-kitab fi thalathat ayyam.
fusha_sentences.english: I read this book in three days.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الكتاب حلو كتير، لازم تقراه.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Had il-ktaab helo ktir, lazim tiqra.
levantine_sentences.english: This book is really great, you must read it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريت كتاب جديد من سوق الكتب.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ishtareet ktaab jdeed min suq il-kutub.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought a new book from the book market.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أشعر بالسعادة حين أرى أسرتي مجتمعة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ash'ur bil-sa'ada hin ara usrati mujtami'a.
fusha_sentences.english: I feel happy when I see my family together.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الطفل السعيد يجعل البيت مليئًا بالبهجة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-tifl al-sa'id yaj'al al-bayt mali'an bil-bahja.
fusha_sentences.english: A happy child fills the home with joy.

levantine_sentences.arabic: مبسوط كتير لأنو اجتحت بالامتحان!
levantine_sentences.english: I'm so happy because I passed the exam!

levantine_sentences.arabic: لما كونك مبسوط، كل شي بصير أحسن.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Lamma tkun mabsut, kull shi byseer ahsan.
levantine_sentences.english: When you're happy, everything gets better.

fusha_sentences.arabic: شعر بالحزن عند سماع الخبر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Sha'ara bil-huzn 'inda sima' al-khabar.
fusha_sentences.english: He felt sad upon hearing the news.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الموسيقى تساعدني حين أكون حزينًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-musiqa tusa'iduni hin akun hazinen.
fusha_sentences.english: Music helps me when I am sad.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شو صاير؟ ليش زعلان هيك؟
levantine_sentences.english: What's wrong? Why are you so sad?

levantine_sentences.arabic: زعلت منو لأنو ما حكالي الحقيقة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Za'alt minno la'anno ma haka-li il-haqiqa.
levantine_sentences.english: I got sad at him because he didn't tell me the truth.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المدينة جميلة بشوارعها وحدائقها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-madina jamila bi-shawari'iha wa hadda'iqiha.
fusha_sentences.english: The city is beautiful with its streets and gardens.

fusha_sentences.arabic: رأيت صورة جميلة في المعرض الفني.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ra'aytu sura jamila fi al-ma'rad al-fanni.
fusha_sentences.english: I saw a beautiful painting at the art exhibition.

levantine_sentences.arabic: يا حلو! هاد المنظر بجنن!
levantine_sentences.english: Oh beautiful! This view is amazing!

levantine_sentences.arabic: الفستان الأزرق عليكِ حلو كتير.
levantine_sentences.english: The blue dress looks really beautiful on you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يأكل الإنسان ليعيش ولا يعيش ليأكل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'kul al-insan li-ya'ish wa la ya'ish li-ya'kul.
fusha_sentences.english: A person eats to live, not lives to eat.

fusha_sentences.arabic: من المهم أن نأكل الفواكه يوميًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Min al-muhimm an na'kul al-fawakiha yawmiyan.
fusha_sentences.english: It's important to eat fruits daily.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تعا نوكل، الغدا جاهز!
levantine_sentences.english: Come eat, lunch is ready!

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما بيوكل كتير، بس بيحب الحلويات.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma byokol ktir, bass bhibb il-halawiyyat.
levantine_sentences.english: He doesn't eat much, but he loves sweets.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتكلم العربية بطلاقة ووضوح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatakallam al-'arabiyya bi-talaqatin wa wuduh.
fusha_sentences.english: He speaks Arabic fluently and clearly.

fusha_sentences.arabic: من المهم أن نتكلم بصدق مع الآخرين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Min al-muhimm an natakallam bi-sidq ma'a al-akharin.
fusha_sentences.english: It's important to speak honestly with others.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بيحكي عربي وإنجليزي وفرنساوي.
levantine_sentences.english: He speaks Arabic, English, and French.

levantine_sentences.arabic: حكيلي إيش صار بالضبط.
levantine_sentences.english: Tell me exactly what happened.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا بدّ أن نفهم الدرس قبل الحفظ.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La budda an nafham al-dars qabla al-hifz.
fusha_sentences.english: We must understand the lesson before memorizing.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يفهم المعلم احتياجات طلابه جيدًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yafham al-mu'allim ihtiyajat tullabihi jayyidan.
fusha_sentences.english: The teacher understands his students' needs well.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما فهمت إيش قصدك، فهمني أكتر.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma fhimt eish qasadak, fahhimni aktar.
levantine_sentences.english: I didn't understand what you meant, explain more.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هو بيفهم بالكمبيوتر أكتر مني.
levantine_sentences.english: He understands computers better than me.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يريد أن يتعلم اللغة العربية الفصحى.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yurid an yata'allam al-lugha al-'arabiyya al-fusha.
fusha_sentences.english: He wants to learn Modern Standard Arabic.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ماذا تريد أن تكون في المستقبل؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Madha turid an takun fi al-mustaqbal?
fusha_sentences.english: What do you want to be in the future?

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدي أروح عمان الصيف الجاي.
levantine_sentences.english: I want to go to Amman this coming summer.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شو بدك تشرب؟ قهوة ولا شاي؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Shu baddak teshrab? Qahwe walla shai?
levantine_sentences.english: What do you want to drink? Coffee or tea?

fusha_sentences.arabic: من يعرف لغات كثيرة يفتح أبوابًا كثيرة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Man ya'rif lughat kathira yaftah abwaban kathira.
fusha_sentences.english: One who knows many languages opens many doors.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يعرف الطالب جميع قواعد اللغة العربية.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'rif al-talib jami' qawa'id al-lugha al-'arabiyya.
fusha_sentences.english: The student knows all the rules of Arabic grammar.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتعرف وين مطعم أبو جبارة؟
levantine_sentences.english: Do you know where Abu Jabbara restaurant is?

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما بعرف ليش تصرف هيك.
levantine_sentences.english: I don't know why he acted like that.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المال وسيلة للعيش لا غاية في حدّ ذاته.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-mal wasilat lil-'aysh la ghayat fi hadd dhatih.
fusha_sentences.english: Money is a means of living, not an end in itself.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ادّخر مالًا كثيرًا لبناء منزله.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Iddakhar malan kathiran li-bina' manzilib.
fusha_sentences.english: He saved a lot of money to build his house.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما معي مصاري هلأ، بدفعلك بكرا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma ma'i massari hala', bdef'a-lak bukra.
levantine_sentences.english: I have no money right now, I'll pay you tomorrow.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الفلوس مش كل شي بالحياة.
levantine_sentences.english: Money is not everything in life.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الوقت كالسيف إن لم تقطعه قطعك.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-waqt kal-sayf in lam taqta'hu qata'ak.
fusha_sentences.english: Time is like a sword; if you don't cut it, it cuts you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ينبغي علينا استثمار الوقت بشكل صحيح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yanbaghi 'alayna isthmar al-waqt bi-shakl sahih.
fusha_sentences.english: We should invest our time properly.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما عندي وقت هلأ، تعبان كتير.
levantine_sentences.english: I have no time right now, I'm very tired.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الوقت طاير، كيف وصلنا لهون؟
levantine_sentences.english: Time is flying, how did we get here?

fusha_sentences.arabic: الصباح الباكر وقت مثالي للدراسة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-sabah al-bakir waqt mithali lil-dirasa.
fusha_sentences.english: Early morning is the ideal time for studying.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أشرقت الشمس في الصباح ونشّطت الجميع.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ashraqat al-shams fi al-sabah wa nashshatat al-jami'.
fusha_sentences.english: The sun shone in the morning and energized everyone.

levantine_sentences.arabic: صبح الخير! كيف كان نومك؟
levantine_sentences.english: Good morning! How was your sleep?

levantine_sentences.arabic: من الصبح وأنا شايل هالحقيبة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Min il-subh w ana shayyil hal-haqibe.
levantine_sentences.english: Since morning I've been carrying this bag.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يسكن الليل سكوتٌ عميق وهدوء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yaskun al-layl sukutun 'amiq wa huduw'.
fusha_sentences.english: Deep silence and calm dwell in the night.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قرأت الرواية كاملة في ليلة واحدة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qara'tu al-riwaya kamila fi laylatin wahida.
fusha_sentences.english: I read the entire novel in one night.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الليل بعمان حلو، في ناس كتير بالشوارع.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-leil b-'Amman helo, fi nas ktir bil-shawari'.
levantine_sentences.english: Nighttime in Amman is beautiful, many people are in the streets.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تصبح على خير، تعبت من هالليلة.
levantine_sentences.english: Goodnight, I'm exhausted from tonight.

fusha_sentences.arabic: سينتهي العمل غدًا بإذن الله.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Sayantahi al-'amal ghadan bi-idhni allah.
fusha_sentences.english: The work will finish tomorrow, God willing.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تؤجّل عمل اليوم إلى الغد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La tu'ajjil 'amal al-yawm ila al-ghad.
fusha_sentences.english: Do not postpone today's work until tomorrow.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بكرا عندي امتحان، لازم أذاكر.
levantine_sentences.english: Tomorrow I have an exam, I need to study.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تعا بكرا نطلع نتمشى بالبلد.
levantine_sentences.english: Come tomorrow and let's go for a walk downtown.

fusha_sentences.arabic: وصل أمس بعد رحلة طويلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Wasala ams ba'da rihla tawila.
fusha_sentences.english: He arrived yesterday after a long journey.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ما حدث أمس لن يتكرر اليوم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ma hadatha ams lan yatakarrar al-yawm.
fusha_sentences.english: What happened yesterday will not repeat today.

levantine_sentences.arabic: إمبارح زرت سيتي سنتر مع صاحبتي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Imbarrih zurt City Center ma' sahibti.
levantine_sentences.english: Yesterday I visited City Centre with my friend.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شفته مبارح بالسوق بالمصطبة.
levantine_sentences.english: I saw him yesterday at the market by the bench.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يجب أن نتصرف الآن دون تأخير.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yajib an natasarraf al-an duna ta'khir.
fusha_sentences.english: We must act now without delay.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الوضع الآن أفضل مما كان عليه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-wad' al-an afdal mimma kan 'alayhi.
fusha_sentences.english: The situation now is better than it was.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هلأ وين؟ مش قاعد هون!
levantine_sentences.english: Now where? He's not sitting here!

levantine_sentences.arabic: أنا مشغول هلق، اتصل فيّ بعدين.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ana mashghul halaq, ittasil fiyyi ba'deen.
levantine_sentences.english: I'm busy now, call me later.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يحبّ السفر لكنه لا يملك الوقت الكافي.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yuhibb al-safar lakinahu la yamlik al-waqt al-kafi.
fusha_sentences.english: He loves travelling but does not have enough time.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأمر صعب لكنه ليس مستحيلًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-amr sa'b lakinahu laysa mustahilan.
fusha_sentences.english: The matter is difficult but not impossible.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدي أجي بس عندي شغل.
levantine_sentences.english: I want to come but I have work.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل زاكي بس الكمية كتير.
levantine_sentences.english: The food is delicious but the portion is too big.

fusha_sentences.arabic: عمّان مدينة تجمع بين الأصالة والحداثة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: 'Amman madina tajma' bayna al-asala wa al-hadatha.
fusha_sentences.english: Amman is a city that combines heritage and modernity.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تعتبر القدس من أقدم مدن العالم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tu'tabar al-Quds min aqdam mudun al-'alam.
fusha_sentences.english: Jerusalem is considered one of the oldest cities in the world.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البلد تغيرت كتير من زمان.
levantine_sentences.english: The city has changed a lot from before.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحب المدينة هون، ناسها طيبين.
levantine_sentences.english: I love this city, its people are kind.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القلب السليم مفتاح الراحة والطمأنينة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qalb al-salim miftah al-raha wa al-tuma'nina.
fusha_sentences.english: A sound heart is the key to peace and tranquility.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تكلّم من القلب وستصل الكلمات.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Takallam min al-qalb wa satusal al-kalimat.
fusha_sentences.english: Speak from the heart and the words will reach.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قلبي بيوجعني لما بشوفه حزين.
levantine_sentences.english: My heart aches when I see him sad.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاي المرأة قلبها ذهب، تساعد الكل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Hay il-mar'a qalba dahab, tsa'id il-kull.
levantine_sentences.english: This woman has a heart of gold, she helps everyone.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اللغة العربية من أغنى لغات العالم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-lugha al-'arabiyya min aghna lughat al-'alam.
fusha_sentences.english: Arabic is one of the richest languages in the world.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تعلّم لغة جديدة يوسّع الآفاق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ta'allum lugha jadida yuwassi' al-afaq.
fusha_sentences.english: Learning a new language broadens horizons.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتحكي كم لغة؟ أنا بحكي تنتين.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Btehki kam lugha? Ana bhiki tintein.
levantine_sentences.english: How many languages do you speak? I speak two.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اللغة العربية صعبة بس حلوة كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-lugha il-'arabiyye sa'be bass helo ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: Arabic is difficult but very beautiful.

fusha_sentences.arabic: التعليم باب مفتوح لمستقبل أفضل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-ta'lim bab maftuh li-mustaqbal afdal.
fusha_sentences.english: Education is an open door to a better future.

fusha_sentences.arabic: طرق الباب ثلاث مرات ولم يجبه أحد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Taraqa al-bab thalatha marrat wa lam yujibhu ahad.
fusha_sentences.english: He knocked on the door three times and no one answered.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سكّر الباب، في هوا بارد من برّا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Sakkar il-bab, fi hawa bared min barra.
levantine_sentences.english: Close the door, there's cold air from outside.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في حدا بيطق الباب، روح شوف مين.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Fi hada bytuq il-bab, ruh shuf min.
levantine_sentences.english: Someone is knocking on the door, go see who it is.

fusha_sentences.arabic: نعم، سأحضر الاجتماع في الموعد المحدد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Na'am, sa-ahdar al-ijtima' fi al-maw'id al-muhaddad.
fusha_sentences.english: Yes, I will attend the meeting at the set time.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أجاب الطالب بنعم حين سأله المعلم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ajaba al-talib bi-na'am hin sa'alahu al-mu'allim.
fusha_sentences.english: The student answered yes when the teacher asked him.

levantine_sentences.arabic: آه، بعرف وين هي المحطة.
levantine_sentences.english: Yes, I know where the station is.

levantine_sentences.arabic: إي والله، أنا موافق!
levantine_sentences.english: Yes indeed, I agree!

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا، لن أوافق على هذا القرار.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La, lan uwafiq 'ala hadha al-qarar.
fusha_sentences.english: No, I will not agree to this decision.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أجابت بـ«لا» وغادرت الغرفة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ajabat bi-la wa ghadat al-ghurfa.
fusha_sentences.english: She answered with 'no' and left the room.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لا، مش قادر أجي اليوم.
levantine_sentences.english: No, I can't come today.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لا شكرًا، ما بدي شي هلأ.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: La shukran, ma biddi shi hala'.
levantine_sentences.english: No thank you, I don't want anything now.

fusha_sentences.arabic: من فضلك، هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Min fadlak, hal yumkinuka musa'adati?
fusha_sentences.english: Please, can you help me?

fusha_sentences.arabic: أرجو منك، من فضلك، الصبر قليلًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Arju minka, min fadlak, al-sabr qalilan.
fusha_sentences.english: I ask you, please, to be patient a little.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لو سمحت، وين دوار الداخلية؟
levantine_sentences.english: Please, where is the Interior Circle?

levantine_sentences.arabic: من فضلك اخفت الصوت، في ناس نايمين.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Min fadlak ikhfit il-sot, fi nas naymeen.
levantine_sentences.english: Please lower the volume, there are people sleeping.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أنا آسف على ما حدث بيننا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ana asif 'ala ma hadatha baynana.
fusha_sentences.english: I am sorry for what happened between us.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أعتذر بصدق عن هذا الخطأ غير المقصود.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: A'tadhir bi-sidq 'an hadha al-khata' ghayr al-maqsud.
fusha_sentences.english: I sincerely apologize for this unintentional mistake.

levantine_sentences.arabic: معلش، ما كنت قاصدك.
levantine_sentences.english: Sorry, I didn't mean you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: آسف كتير على التأخير، في زحمة بالطريق.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Asif ktir 'ala il-ta'khir, fi zahme bil-tariq.
levantine_sentences.english: I'm really sorry for being late, there's traffic on the road.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأم هي أول معلم في حياة الطفل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-umm hiya awwal mu'allim fi hayat al-tifl.
fusha_sentences.english: A mother is the first teacher in a child's life.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تُضحّي الأم بكل شيء من أجل أبنائها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tudahhi al-umm bi-kulli shay' min ajl abna'iha.
fusha_sentences.english: A mother sacrifices everything for her children.

levantine_sentences.arabic: إمّي بتحكي معي كل يوم بالتلفون.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Immi btehki ma'i kull yom bil-telfon.
levantine_sentences.english: My mom talks to me every day on the phone.

levantine_sentences.arabic: إمو طبّخت منسف اليوم، حلو كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Immo tabbakhat mansaf il-yom, helo ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: His mom made mansaf today, it's very delicious.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأب هو ركيزة الأسرة وقائدها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-ab huwa rakizat al-usra wa qa'iduha.
fusha_sentences.english: The father is the pillar and leader of the family.

fusha_sentences.arabic: علّمني أبي قيمة العمل الجاد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: 'Allamani abi qimat al-'amal al-jadd.
fusha_sentences.english: My father taught me the value of hard work.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أبوي رجع من الشغل متأخر إمبارح.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Abui rija' min il-shughul mit'akhkhar imbarrih.
levantine_sentences.english: My dad came back from work late yesterday.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أبو أحمد كرم كتير، دايمًا بيساعد الناس.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Abu Ahmad karim ktir, dayiman bysa'id il-nas.
levantine_sentences.english: Ahmad's father is very generous, he always helps people.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أخي الأكبر يعمل في مجال الهندسة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Akhi al-akbar ya'mal fi majal al-handasa.
fusha_sentences.english: My older brother works in the field of engineering.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تشاور مع أخيك قبل أن تتخذ أي قرار.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tashawar ma'a akhika qabla an tattakhidha ayy qarar.
fusha_sentences.english: Consult with your brother before making any decision.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أخوي صغير بس أذكى مني بكتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Akhui zghir bass adhka minni b-ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: My brother is younger but much smarter than me.

levantine_sentences.arabic: رحت مع أخوي على فلافل صاحب.
levantine_sentences.english: I went with my brother to Sahib Falafel.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أختي الصغيرة تدرس الطب في الجامعة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ukhti al-saghira tadrus al-tibb fi al-jami'a.
fusha_sentences.english: My younger sister studies medicine at the university.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العلاقة بين الأخت وأخيها رابطة مقدسة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'alaqa bayna al-ukht wa akhiha rabita muqaddasa.
fusha_sentences.english: The relationship between a sister and her brother is a sacred bond.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أختي ساعدتني بالمذاكرة لما كنت تعبان.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ukhti sa'adatni bil-muzakara lamma kunt ta'ban.
levantine_sentences.english: My sister helped me study when I was sick.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أختك طلعت معنا أمس؟ إي طلعت.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ukhtik tla'it ma'na ams? Ee tla'it.
levantine_sentences.english: Did your sister come out with us yesterday? Yes she did.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المعلم الجيد يُلهم طلابه ويحفزهم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-mu'allim al-jayyid yulhim tullabahy wa yuhaffizuhum.
fusha_sentences.english: A good teacher inspires and motivates students.

fusha_sentences.arabic: كرّم الطلاب معلمهم في نهاية العام الدراسي.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Karrma al-tullab mu'allimahum fi nihayat al-'am al-dirasi.
fusha_sentences.english: Students honored their teacher at the end of the school year.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأستاذ خالد شارح كتير منيح.
levantine_sentences.english: Teacher Khalid explains very well.

levantine_sentences.arabic: المدرّسة طلبت منا نحضّر الدرس لبكرا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-mudarrisa talabat minna nhadddir il-dars la-bukra.
levantine_sentences.english: The teacher asked us to prepare the lesson for tomorrow.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتميز الطالب المجتهد بالمثابرة والانضباط.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatamayyaz al-talib al-mujtahid bil-muthabara wal-indibat.
fusha_sentences.english: A hardworking student is distinguished by perseverance and discipline.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يدرس الطالب ساعات طويلة استعدادًا للامتحان.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yadrus al-talib sa'at tawila isti'dadan lil-imtihan.
fusha_sentences.english: The student studies long hours in preparation for the exam.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الطالب هاد شاطر كتير بالرياضيات.
levantine_sentences.english: This student is very good at mathematics.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في كتير طلاب بالجامعة من مناطق مختلفة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Fi ktir tullab bil-jami'a min manateq mukhtalife.
levantine_sentences.english: There are many students at the university from different areas.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المدرسة هي البيت الثاني للطالب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-madrasa hiya al-bayt al-thani lil-talib.
fusha_sentences.english: School is the student's second home.

fusha_sentences.arabic: افتتحت المدرسة الجديدة أبوابها هذا العام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Iftatahat al-madrasa al-jadida abwabiha hadha al-'am.
fusha_sentences.english: The new school opened its doors this year.

levantine_sentences.arabic: وصلت على المدرسة متأخر اليوم.
levantine_sentences.english: I arrived at school late today.

levantine_sentences.arabic: المدرسة تبعتنا فيها مسبح وملعب كبير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-madrasse taba'tna fiha masbah w mal'ab kbir.
levantine_sentences.english: Our school has a pool and a big playground.

fusha_sentences.arabic: استوعب الطلاب الدرس بشكل جيد اليوم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Istawab al-tullab al-dars bi-shakl jayyid al-yawm.
fusha_sentences.english: The students understood the lesson well today.

fusha_sentences.arabic: في كل تجربة حياتية درس نتعلمه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Fi kulli tajruba hayatiyya dars nata'allamuhu.
fusha_sentences.english: In every life experience there is a lesson to learn.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الدرس اليوم كان صعب، ما فهمت كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-dars il-yom kan sa'b, ma fhimt ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: Today's lesson was difficult, I didn't understand much.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحصة الجاية بتكون رياضيات أو علوم؟
levantine_sentences.english: Will the next period be math or science?

fusha_sentences.arabic: الخبز غذاء أساسي في معظم الثقافات.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-khubz ghidha' asasi fi mu'zam al-thaqafat.
fusha_sentences.english: Bread is a staple food in most cultures.

fusha_sentences.arabic: رائحة الخبز الطازج تُبهج النفس.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ra'ihat al-khubz al-tazij tubbhij al-nafs.
fusha_sentences.english: The smell of fresh bread delights the soul.

levantine_sentences.arabic: روح جيب خبز من الفرن قبل ما يقفل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ruh jeeb khubz min il-furn qabul ma yqfel.
levantine_sentences.english: Go get bread from the bakery before it closes.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الخبز التنور تبعنا طازج كل صبح.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-khubz il-tannur taba'na tazij kull subh.
levantine_sentences.english: Our tandoor bread is fresh every morning.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القهوة العربية رمز الكرم والضيافة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qahwa al-'arabiyya ramz al-karam wal-diyafa.
fusha_sentences.english: Arabic coffee is a symbol of generosity and hospitality.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أشرب فنجانًا من القهوة كل صباح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ashrabu finjaanan min al-qahwa kull sabah.
fusha_sentences.english: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدك قهوة؟ عم باعمل لحالي.
levantine_sentences.english: Do you want coffee? I'm making some for myself.

levantine_sentences.arabic: القهوة بالهيل أحسن من القهوة العادية.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-qahwe bil-heil ahsan min il-qahwe il-'adiyye.
levantine_sentences.english: Cardamom coffee is better than regular coffee.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يشرب المصريون الشاي في معظم أوقات اليوم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yashrabu al-masriyyun al-shay fi mu'zam awqat al-yawm.
fusha_sentences.english: Egyptians drink tea most times of the day.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أضف قليلًا من النعناع إلى الشاي.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Adif qalilan min al-na'na' ila al-shay.
fusha_sentences.english: Add a little mint to the tea.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شاي بالنعنع ولا سادة؟
levantine_sentences.english: Tea with mint or plain?

levantine_sentences.arabic: في شي أحسن من شاي ساخن بالشتا؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Fi shi ahsan min shai sakhin bil-shita?
levantine_sentences.english: Is there anything better than hot tea in winter?

fusha_sentences.arabic: الحليب غني بالكالسيوم والبروتين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-halib ghani bil-kalsyum wal-burutin.
fusha_sentences.english: Milk is rich in calcium and protein.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تشرب الأطفال الحليب لينموا بصحة جيدة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tashrabu al-atfal al-halib li-yanmu bi-sihha jayyida.
fusha_sentences.english: Children drink milk to grow up healthy.

levantine_sentences.arabic: جيب حليب من الدكان لما ترجع.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Jeeb halib min il-dukkan lamma tirja'.
levantine_sentences.english: Bring milk from the store when you come back.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحليب خلص، لازم نشتري.
levantine_sentences.english: The milk is finished, we need to buy some.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأرز طبق أساسي في المطبخ الأردني.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-aruzz tabaq asasi fi al-matbakh al-urdunni.
fusha_sentences.english: Rice is a staple dish in Jordanian cuisine.

fusha_sentences.arabic: طهت الأم كميةً كبيرة من الأرز للضيوف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tahhat al-umm kammiyya kabira min al-aruzz lil-duyuf.
fusha_sentences.english: The mother cooked a large amount of rice for the guests.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الرز بالشعيرية أحسن من الرز السادة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-rizz bil-sha'iriyye ahsan min il-rizz il-sade.
levantine_sentences.english: Rice with vermicelli is better than plain rice.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عملت رز وفريكة مع اللحمة اليوم.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Amalit rizz w freike ma' il-lahme il-yom.
levantine_sentences.english: I made rice and freekeh with meat today.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الوردة الحمراء رمز الحب والعاطفة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-warda al-hamra' ramz al-hubb wal-'atifa.
fusha_sentences.english: The red rose is a symbol of love and affection.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القلب الأحمر يُعبّر عن المشاعر العميقة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qalb al-ahmar yu'abbir 'an al-masha'ir al-'amiqa.
fusha_sentences.english: The red heart expresses deep emotions.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريت فستان أحمر للعيد.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought a red dress for Eid.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الضو الأحمر يعني وقف، مش مشي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-daw il-ahmar ya'ni waqif, mish mashi.
levantine_sentences.english: The red light means stop, not go.

fusha_sentences.arabic: السماء الزرقاء تجلب السكينة للنفس.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-sama' al-zarqa' tajlib al-sakina lil-nafs.
fusha_sentences.english: The blue sky brings tranquility to the soul.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُعدّ اللون الأزرق من أكثر الألوان هدوءًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yu'addu al-lawn al-azraq min akthar al-alwan hudu'an.
fusha_sentences.english: Blue is considered one of the most calming colors.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البحر أزرق وصافي اليوم، يا حلو!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-bahr azraq w safi il-yom, ya helo!
levantine_sentences.english: The sea is blue and clear today, how beautiful!

levantine_sentences.arabic: عيونك زرقا ولا خضرا؟
levantine_sentences.english: Are your eyes blue or green?

fusha_sentences.arabic: اللون الأخضر يرمز إلى الطبيعة والحياة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-lawn al-akhdar yarmuz ila al-tabi'a wal-hayah.
fusha_sentences.english: The color green symbolizes nature and life.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تُغطي الأشجار الخضراء جانبَي الطريق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tughabbi al-ashjar al-khadra' janibay al-tariq.
fusha_sentences.english: Green trees cover both sides of the road.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البيت تبعنا فيه حديقة خضرا كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-beit taba'na fih hadiqe khadra ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: Our house has a very green garden.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شيل اللمبة الخضرا وحط الصفرا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Shil il-lumbe il-khadra w hutt il-safra.
levantine_sentences.english: Remove the green bulb and put the yellow one.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الثلج الأبيض يغطي قمم الجبال في الشتاء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-thalj al-abyad yughatti qimam al-jibal fi al-shita'.
fusha_sentences.english: White snow covers mountain peaks in winter.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ترمز الراية البيضاء إلى السلام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tarmuz al-raya al-bayda' ila al-salam.
fusha_sentences.english: The white flag symbolizes peace.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الثوب الأبيض أحسن للصيف.
levantine_sentences.english: A white robe is better for summer.

levantine_sentences.arabic: صبغ الجدران أبيض خلّى البيت يبان كبير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Sabbagh il-judran abyad khalla il-beit yban kbir.
levantine_sentences.english: Painting the walls white made the house look bigger.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اللون الأسود يضفي على الملابس رونقًا خاصًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-lawn al-aswad yudfi 'ala al-malabis rawnaqan khasan.
fusha_sentences.english: The color black gives clothes a special elegance.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الليل الأسود الحالك أجمل ما يُرى فيه النجوم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-layl al-aswad al-halik ajmal ma yura fihi al-nujum.
fusha_sentences.english: In the darkest night, the stars are most beautiful to see.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لبست أسود لأني حزين هالفترة.
levantine_sentences.english: I wore black because I've been sad lately.

levantine_sentences.arabic: القهوة السودا بدون سكر هيك أشرب.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-qahwe il-soda bidun sukkar heik beshrab.
levantine_sentences.english: I drink black coffee without sugar like that.

fusha_sentences.arabic: دوّار عباد الشمس الأصفر يُبهج الحقول.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Dawwar 'abbad al-shams al-asfar yubhij al-huqul.
fusha_sentences.english: The yellow sunflower brightens the fields.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اشترت الطفلة فستانًا أصفر زاهيًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ishtarat al-tifla fustanan asfara zahiyan.
fusha_sentences.english: The little girl bought a bright yellow dress.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شجرة الليمون مليانة حبات صفرا.
levantine_sentences.english: The lemon tree is full of yellow fruits.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ليش وجهك أصفر؟ كل شي تمام؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Leish wajhak asfar? Kull shi tamam?
levantine_sentences.english: Why does your face look pale? Is everything okay?

fusha_sentences.arabic: واحد زائد واحد يساوي اثنين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Wahid za'id wahid yusawi ithnayn.
fusha_sentences.english: One plus one equals two.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يكفي درهمٌ واحد لشراء هذه الحلوى.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yakfi dirhamun wahid li-shira' hadhihi al-halwa.
fusha_sentences.english: One dirham is enough to buy this sweet.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدي واحد فلافل بدون حارّة.
levantine_sentences.english: I want one falafel without hot sauce.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في واحد هون بسألك عنك.
levantine_sentences.english: There's someone here asking about you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اشترى كتابَين اثنين من معرض الكتاب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ishtara kitabayn ithnayn min ma'rad al-kitab.
fusha_sentences.english: He bought two books from the book fair.

fusha_sentences.arabic: مرّت ساعتان اثنتان على انتظاره.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Marrat sa'atan ithnatan 'ala intidharihi.
fusha_sentences.english: Two hours passed while waiting for him.

levantine_sentences.arabic: جيبلي تنين قهوة لو سمحت.
levantine_sentences.english: Bring me two coffees please.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريت تنين تذكرة للفيلم.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought two tickets for the movie.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يقوم المثلث على ثلاثة أضلاع.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yaqum al-muthalath 'ala thalatha adla'.
fusha_sentences.english: A triangle is based on three sides.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قرأت ثلاثة كتب خلال إجازة الصيف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qara'tu thalatha kutub khilal ijazat al-sayf.
fusha_sentences.english: I read three books during the summer vacation.

levantine_sentences.arabic: رجعت على البيت بعد تلاتة أيام.
levantine_sentences.english: I came back home after three days.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عندي تلاتة امتحانات هالأسبوع.
levantine_sentences.english: I have three exams this week.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العشرة الأوائل في الصف يحصلون على جوائز.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'ashara al-awa'il fi al-saff yahsalun 'ala jawa'iz.
fusha_sentences.english: The top ten in the class receive prizes.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتدرب الفريق عشرة ساعات في الأسبوع.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatadarrab al-fariq 'ashara sa'at fi al-usbu'.
fusha_sentences.english: The team trains ten hours per week.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عطيني عشرة دقائق وأنا معك.
levantine_sentences.english: Give me ten minutes and I'll be with you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريته بعشرة دنانير.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought it for ten dinars.

fusha_sentences.arabic: بلغت نسبة نجاحه مئة بالمئة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Balaghat nisbat najahibi mi'a bil-mi'a.
fusha_sentences.english: His success rate reached one hundred percent.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتجاوز عدد طلاب الكلية مئة طالب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatajawaz 'adad tullab al-kulliyya mi'at talib.
fusha_sentences.english: The number of college students exceeds a hundred.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد البضاعة بالمية دينار، رخيصة!
levantine_sentences.english: This item costs one hundred dinars, cheap!

levantine_sentences.arabic: مية بالمية هاد الشي صح.
levantine_sentences.english: One hundred percent this thing is correct.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تشرق الشمس في الشرق وتغرب في الغرب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tashriq al-shams fi al-sharq wa taghrib fi al-gharb.
fusha_sentences.english: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ضوء الشمس مصدر الطاقة والحياة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Daw' al-shams masdar al-taqa wal-hayah.
fusha_sentences.english: Sunlight is the source of energy and life.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الشمس حارقة اليوم، لبس واقي شمس.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-shams harqa il-yom, labis waqi shams.
levantine_sentences.english: The sun is scorching today, wear sunscreen.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحب أشوف غروب الشمس من على الجبل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Bhibb ashuf ghurub il-shams min 'al il-jabal.
levantine_sentences.english: I love watching the sunset from the mountain.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القمر يُضيء الليل بضوئه الفضي.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qamar yudi' al-layl bi-daw'ihi al-fiddi.
fusha_sentences.english: The moon lights up the night with its silver glow.

fusha_sentences.arabic: رصد الفلكيون القمر بالتلسكوب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Rasada al-falakiyyun al-qamar bil-tiliskub.
fusha_sentences.english: Astronomers observed the moon with a telescope.

levantine_sentences.arabic: القمر الليلة كامل وحلو كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-qamar il-leile kamil w helo ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: The moon tonight is full and very beautiful.

levantine_sentences.arabic: يا قمر! كيف هيك وجهها حلو.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ya qamar! Kif heik wajha helo.
levantine_sentences.english: Like the moon! How beautiful her face is like that.

fusha_sentences.arabic: هطل المطر بغزارة طوال الليل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Hatala al-matar bi-ghazara tawala al-layl.
fusha_sentences.english: It rained heavily throughout the night.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُنعش المطر الأرض ويُحيي الزرع.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yun'ish al-matar al-ard wa yuhyi al-zar'.
fusha_sentences.english: Rain refreshes the earth and revives crops.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عم بشتي، لازم تاخد مظلة معك.
levantine_sentences.english: It's raining, you need to take an umbrella with you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحب ريحة المطر على الأرض، شي بجنن.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Bhibb rihet il-matar 'al il-ard, shi byjannen.
levantine_sentences.english: I love the smell of rain on the ground, it's amazing.

fusha_sentences.arabic: السماء الصافية تمتد بلا حدود.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-sama' al-safiya tamtadd bi-la hudud.
fusha_sentences.english: The clear sky stretches endlessly.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تزيّن النجوم السماء في ليالي الصحراء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tuzayyin al-nujum al-sama' fi layali al-sahra'.
fusha_sentences.english: Stars decorate the sky on desert nights.

levantine_sentences.arabic: السما اليوم زرقا وما في غيم.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-sama il-yom zarqa w ma fi ghaym.
levantine_sentences.english: The sky is blue today and there are no clouds.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شفت طيارة عم تطير بالسما هلأ.
levantine_sentences.english: I just saw a plane flying in the sky.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يمتد البحر الأحمر على طول ساحل العقبة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yamtadd al-bahr al-ahmar 'ala tul sahil al-'Aqaba.
fusha_sentences.english: The Red Sea extends along the coast of Aqaba.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يعشق الصيادون صخب البحر وأمواجه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'shaq al-sayyadin sakhab al-bahr wa amwajahu.
fusha_sentences.english: Fishermen are captivated by the roar of the sea and its waves.

levantine_sentences.arabic: روحنا على العقبة وسبحنا بالبحر.
levantine_sentences.english: We went to Aqaba and swam in the sea.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البحر هناك أزرق وصافي ما شاء الله.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-bahr hunak azraq w safi ma sha' allah.
levantine_sentences.english: The sea there is blue and clear, mashallah.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تكتسي قمم الجبال بالثلج في فصل الشتاء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Taktasi qimam al-jibal bil-thalj fi fasl al-shita'.
fusha_sentences.english: Mountain peaks are covered with snow in winter.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتسلق المغامرون الجبال بحثًا عن الإثارة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatasallaq al-mughammirun al-jibal bahathan 'an al-ithara.
fusha_sentences.english: Adventurers climb mountains in search of excitement.

levantine_sentences.arabic: جبال عجلون خضر وحلوة كتير بالربيع.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Jibal Ajlun khudr w helwe ktir bil-rabi'.
levantine_sentences.english: The mountains of Ajloun are very green and beautiful in spring.

levantine_sentences.arabic: صعدنا الجبل ومشينا ساعتين.
levantine_sentences.english: We climbed the mountain and walked for two hours.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تتفتح الزهور في الربيع بألوانها الزاهية.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tatafattah al-zuhur fi al-rabi' bi-alwaniha al-zahiya.
fusha_sentences.english: Flowers bloom in spring with their vivid colors.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أهدى الشاب زهرةً للفتاة تعبيرًا عن مشاعره.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ahda al-shabab zahratan lil-fata ta'biran 'an masha'irib.
fusha_sentences.english: The young man gave the girl a flower to express his feelings.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريت وردات حمرا لأمي.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought red flowers for my mom.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحديقة مليانة ورود وزهور، يا حلو!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-hadiqa malyane wrud w zuhur, ya helo!
levantine_sentences.english: The garden is full of roses and flowers, how beautiful!

fusha_sentences.arabic: الشجرة العتيقة شاهدٌ على مرور الزمن.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-shajara al-'atiqa shahidun 'ala murur al-zaman.
fusha_sentences.english: The ancient tree is a witness to the passage of time.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تُنتج شجرة الزيتون ثمارًا طوال القرون.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tuntij shajarat al-zaytun thamaran tawala al-qurun.
fusha_sentences.english: The olive tree produces fruit throughout the centuries.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في شجرة تين كبيرة بأول البيت.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Fi shajarat teen kbiire b-awwal il-beit.
levantine_sentences.english: There's a big fig tree at the front of the house.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قطفنا الزيتون من الشجرة اليوم.
levantine_sentences.english: We picked olives from the tree today.

fusha_sentences.arabic: النار تدفئ في الشتاء لكنها تُؤذي بالقرب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-nar tuda'fi' fi al-shita' lakinaha tu'dhi bil-qurb.
fusha_sentences.english: Fire warms in winter but harms when close.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اشتعلت النار في الغابة بسبب الجفاف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ishta'alat al-nar fi al-ghaba bi-sabab al-jafaf.
fusha_sentences.english: Fire broke out in the forest due to drought.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شعلنا نار وقعدنا حواليها بالشتا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Sha'alna nar w qa'adna hwaliyha bil-shita.
levantine_sentences.english: We lit a fire and sat around it in winter.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل على النار أحسن طعمًا من الفرن.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-akil 'ala il-nar ahsan ta'man min il-furn.
levantine_sentences.english: Food cooked on fire tastes better than oven-cooked.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الكلب يُعدّ من أوفى الحيوانات للإنسان.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-kalb yu'add min awfa al-hayawanat lil-insan.
fusha_sentences.english: The dog is considered one of the most loyal animals to humans.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُستخدم الكلب في عمليات الإنقاذ والبحث.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yustakhdim al-kalb fi 'amaliyyat al-inqadh wal-bahth.
fusha_sentences.english: Dogs are used in rescue and search operations.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عندنا كلب بالبيت اسمه روكي.
levantine_sentences.english: We have a dog at home named Rocky.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الكلب نبح طول الليل وما خلانا ننام.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-kalb nabah tul il-leil w ma khallana nnam.
levantine_sentences.english: The dog barked all night and wouldn't let us sleep.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القطة حيوان أليف نظيف ومستقل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qitta hayawan alif nadhif wa mustaqill.
fusha_sentences.english: The cat is a clean and independent pet.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تنام القطة معظم ساعات اليوم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tanam al-qitta mu'zam sa'at al-yawm.
fusha_sentences.english: The cat sleeps most hours of the day.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في بسة جنب الباب عم تطلب أكل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Fi basse janb il-bab 'am titlub akil.
levantine_sentences.english: There's a cat by the door asking for food.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البسة تبعتنا ولدت أربع بسيسات.
levantine_sentences.english: Our cat gave birth to four kittens.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُرمز للطائر في الشعر بالحرية والانطلاق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yurmaz lil-ta'ir fi al-shi'r bil-hurriyya wal-intilaaq.
fusha_sentences.english: Birds symbolize freedom and soaring in poetry.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تهاجر الطيور جنوبًا في فصل الخريف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tuhajir al-tuyur januban fi fasl al-kharif.
fusha_sentences.english: Birds migrate south in autumn.

levantine_sentences.arabic: في عصفور صغير عم يغني بالحديقة.
levantine_sentences.english: There's a small bird singing in the garden.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الطيور الصباحية بتصحّيني كل يوم.
levantine_sentences.english: The morning birds wake me up every day.

fusha_sentences.arabic: السمكة حيوان مائي يعيش في البحار والأنهار.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-samaka hayawan ma'i ya'ish fi al-bihar wal-anhar.
fusha_sentences.english: Fish is an aquatic animal living in seas and rivers.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُعدّ السمك من أغنى المصادر الغذائية بالبروتين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yu'addu al-samak min aghna al-masadir al-ghidha'iyya bil-burutin.
fusha_sentences.english: Fish is one of the richest food sources in protein.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اكلنا سمك مقلي على ضفاف البحر.
levantine_sentences.english: We ate fried fish by the seashore.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتحب سمك مشوي ولا مقلي؟
levantine_sentences.english: Do you like grilled or fried fish?

fusha_sentences.arabic: الحصان العربي الأصيل مشهور بسرعته وجماله.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-hisan al-'arabi al-asil mashhur bi-sur'atihi wa jamalihi.
fusha_sentences.english: The purebred Arabian horse is famous for its speed and beauty.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ركب الفارس حصانه وانطلق عبر الصحراء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Rakiba al-faris hisanahu wa intalaqa 'abra al-sahra'.
fusha_sentences.english: The knight rode his horse and galloped across the desert.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ركبت حصان للأول بحياتي بالبتراء.
levantine_sentences.english: I rode a horse for the first time in my life at Petra.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحصان هاد سريع كتير وجميل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-hisan had sari' ktir w jamil.
levantine_sentences.english: This horse is very fast and beautiful.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يحمي الخوذة الرأس من الإصابات.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yahmi al-khudha al-ra's min al-isabat.
fusha_sentences.english: A helmet protects the head from injuries.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أصابه صداع شديد في الرأس.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Asabahu suda' shadid fi al-ra's.
fusha_sentences.english: He got a severe headache.

levantine_sentences.arabic: راسي بيوجعني من الصبح.
levantine_sentences.english: My head has been hurting since morning.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ارفع راسك وكون واثق من حالك.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Irfa' rasak w kun wathiq min halak.
levantine_sentences.english: Hold your head up and be confident in yourself.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العين هي نافذة الروح على العالم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'ayn hiya nafidhat al-ruh 'ala al-'alam.
fusha_sentences.english: The eye is the window of the soul to the world.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تحمي الأجفان العين من الأتربة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tahmi al-ajfan al-'ayn min al-athriba.
fusha_sentences.english: Eyelids protect the eye from dust.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عيني بتوجعني من كتر الشاشة.
levantine_sentences.english: My eye hurts from too much screen time.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عيونك الخضر مشهورين بالمدرسة كلها!
levantine_sentences.english: Your green eyes are famous throughout the whole school!

fusha_sentences.arabic: مدّ يده لمساعدة زميله المتعثر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Madda yadahu li-musa'adat zamilihi al-muta'aththir.
fusha_sentences.english: He extended his hand to help his struggling colleague.

fusha_sentences.arabic: باليد تُبنى الحضارات وتُصنع المعجزات.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Bil-yad tubna al-hadaraat wa tusna' al-mu'jizat.
fusha_sentences.english: With the hand civilizations are built and miracles are made.

levantine_sentences.arabic: يسلمو إيديك على الطبخ الحلو.
levantine_sentences.english: Bless your hands for the wonderful cooking.

levantine_sentences.arabic: أعطيني إيدك قبل ما تعبر الشارع.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: A'tini iidak qabul ma ta'bir il-shari'.
levantine_sentences.english: Give me your hand before you cross the street.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تؤلمه قدمه بعد المشي الطويل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tu'limuhu qadamahu ba'da al-mashi al-tawil.
fusha_sentences.english: His foot hurts after the long walk.

fusha_sentences.arabic: وطأت قدماه أرض المطار للمرة الأولى.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Wata'at qadamahu ard al-matar lil-marra al-ula.
fusha_sentences.english: His feet stepped on the airport floor for the first time.

levantine_sentences.arabic: رجلي بتوجعني من كتر الوقوف.
levantine_sentences.english: My foot hurts from standing too long.

levantine_sentences.arabic: خلع حذاءه وحط رجله بالماء البارد.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Khala' hadha'u w hatt rijlo bil-may il-bared.
levantine_sentences.english: He took off his shoe and put his foot in the cold water.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأذن الصاغية أثمن هدية يمكن تقديمها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-udhn al-saghiya athamm hadiyya yumkin taqdimuha.
fusha_sentences.english: A listening ear is the most precious gift you can give.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أصابته طنين في الأذن بعد الحفلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Asabathu tanin fi al-udhn ba'da al-hafla.
fusha_sentences.english: He got ringing in his ear after the concert.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ودني بتوجعني من هالزكام اللعين.
levantine_sentences.english: My ear hurts from this awful cold.

levantine_sentences.arabic: حكيلك مرتين وما دخل بودنك!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Haki-lak marrtein w ma dakhal b-wudnak!
levantine_sentences.english: I told you twice and it didn't go into your ear!

fusha_sentences.arabic: الأنف يُميّز الروائح ويُصفّي الهواء.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-anf yumayyiz al-rawa'ih wa yusaffi al-hawa'.
fusha_sentences.english: The nose distinguishes smells and filters air.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُعاني المريض من احتقان في الأنف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yu'ani al-marid min ihtiqan fi al-anf.
fusha_sentences.english: The patient suffers from nasal congestion.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ريحة الطبخ وصلت على أنفي من الشارع.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Rihet il-tabkh wasalit 'ala anfi min il-shari'.
levantine_sentences.english: The smell of cooking reached my nose from the street.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تعبان؟ أنفك أحمر وعيونك دامعة.
levantine_sentences.english: Are you sick? Your nose is red and your eyes are watery.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الكلمة الطيبة تخرج من فمٍ كريم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-kalima al-tayyiba takhruj min fammin karim.
fusha_sentences.english: A kind word comes from a generous mouth.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تتكلم وفمك ممتلئ بالطعام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La tatakallam wa fammuka mumtali' bil-ta'am.
fusha_sentences.english: Do not speak with your mouth full of food.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تمّك كبير بس قلبك أكبر.
levantine_sentences.english: Your mouth is big but your heart is bigger.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سكّر تمّك لما الكبار عم يحكوا.
levantine_sentences.english: Keep your mouth closed when elders are speaking.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يحلم كل طفل بمستقبل كبير ومشرق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yahlam kull tifl bi-mustaqbal kabir wa mushriq.
fusha_sentences.english: Every child dreams of a big and bright future.

fusha_sentences.arabic: بنوا مبنى كبيرًا في وسط المدينة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Banaw mabna kabiran fi wasat al-madina.
fusha_sentences.english: They built a big building in the city center.

levantine_sentences.arabic: البيت كبير بس محتاج تجديد.
levantine_sentences.english: The house is big but needs renovation.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عنده قلب كبير، بساعد كل الناس.
levantine_sentences.english: He has a big heart, he helps everyone.

fusha_sentences.arabic: من الصغير تُبنى العادات الحسنة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Min al-saghir tubna al-'adat al-hasana.
fusha_sentences.english: Good habits are built from a young age.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اشترى شقة صغيرة لكنها مريحة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ishtara shaqqa saghira lakinaha mriha.
fusha_sentences.english: He bought a small but comfortable apartment.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الحجم كتير زغير، في أكبر منو؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Had il-hajm ktir zghir, fi akbar minno?
levantine_sentences.english: This size is too small, is there a bigger one?

levantine_sentences.arabic: لما كان زغير كان يحب يرسم.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Lamma kan zghir kan yhibb yirsim.
levantine_sentences.english: When he was small he loved to draw.

fusha_sentences.arabic: افتتح مطعم جديد في الحي بالأمس.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Iftataḥa mat'am jadid fi al-hayy bil-ams.
fusha_sentences.english: A new restaurant opened in the neighborhood yesterday.

fusha_sentences.arabic: كل يوم جديد هو فرصة لبداية جديدة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Kull yawm jadid huwa fursa li-bidaya jadida.
fusha_sentences.english: Every new day is a chance for a new beginning.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شفت سيارته الجديدة؟ حلوة كتير.
levantine_sentences.english: Did you see his new car? It's very nice.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لبست تياب جديدة للعيد.
levantine_sentences.english: I wore new clothes for Eid.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المدينة القديمة تحمل إرثًا حضاريًا عريقًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-madina al-qadima tahmil irathan hadariyan 'ariqan.
fusha_sentences.english: The old city carries a deep civilizational heritage.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يحتفظ جدي بكتب قديمة نادرة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yahtafiz jaddi bi-kutub qadima nadira.
fusha_sentences.english: My grandfather keeps rare old books.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الجهاز قديم، لازم تشتري غيره.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Had il-jihaz qdim, lazim tishtiri gheiro.
levantine_sentences.english: This device is old, you need to buy another one.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بحب الأغاني القديمة أكتر من الجديدة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Bhibb il-aghani il-qdime aktar min il-jdide.
levantine_sentences.english: I prefer old songs over new ones.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الطقس حار جدًا في فصل الصيف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-taqas harr jiddan fi fasl al-sayf.
fusha_sentences.english: The weather is very hot in summer.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تلمس الإناء الحار بيديك مباشرة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La talmas al-ina' al-harr bi-yadayk mubashara.
fusha_sentences.english: Don't touch the hot pot with your hands directly.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الجو حار اليوم، بدي مي بارد.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-jaww harr il-yom, biddi may bared.
levantine_sentences.english: It's hot today, I want cold water.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل لسا سخن، استنى شوي.
levantine_sentences.english: The food is still hot, wait a little.

fusha_sentences.arabic: شتاء عمّان بارد ورطب في الغالب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Shita' 'Amman barid wa ratib fi al-ghalab.
fusha_sentences.english: Amman's winter is usually cold and humid.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يشرب الناس الشاي الساخن في الطقس البارد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yashrabu al-nas al-shay al-sakhin fi al-taqas al-barid.
fusha_sentences.english: People drink hot tea in cold weather.

levantine_sentences.arabic: جيبلي مي بارد من الثلاجة.
levantine_sentences.english: Bring me cold water from the fridge.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الجو بارد كتير اليوم، لبس جاكيت.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-jaww bared ktir il-yom, libis jakkit.
levantine_sentences.english: It's very cold today, wear a jacket.

fusha_sentences.arabic: القطار السريع يختصر وقت السفر إلى النصف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-qitar al-sari' yakhtasir waqt al-safar ila al-nisf.
fusha_sentences.english: The fast train cuts travel time in half.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الحل السريع ليس دائمًا الأفضل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-hall al-sari' laysa da'iman al-afdal.
fusha_sentences.english: The fast solution is not always the best.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سيارته سريعة كتير، بخوّف!
levantine_sentences.english: His car is very fast, it's scary!

levantine_sentences.arabic: تكلم بس بطي شوي، ما فهمت عليك.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Takallem bass bati shwayy, ma fhimt 'alak.
levantine_sentences.english: Talk but slow down a bit, I didn't understand you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: التقدم البطيء خيرٌ من الوقوف التام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-taqaddum al-bati' khayrun min al-wuquf al-tamm.
fusha_sentences.english: Slow progress is better than a complete stop.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتحرك بطيئًا بسبب الإصابة في قدمه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yataharrk bati'an bi-sabab al-isabha fi qadamih.
fusha_sentences.english: He moves slowly due to the injury in his foot.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الانترنت بطيء كتير اليوم، شو صاير؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-internet bati ktir il-yom, shu sayir?
levantine_sentences.english: The internet is very slow today, what's happening?

levantine_sentences.arabic: تمشي بطي، الكل راح قدامك.
levantine_sentences.english: You walk slowly, everyone has gone ahead of you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: السؤال سهل لمن درس جيدًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-su'al sahl li-man darasa jayyidan.
fusha_sentences.english: The question is easy for one who studied well.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تعلّم اللغة العربية سهل إذا اتبعت المنهج الصحيح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ta'allum al-lugha al-'arabiyya sahl idha ittaba'ta al-manhaj al-sahih.
fusha_sentences.english: Learning Arabic is easy if you follow the right method.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الامتحان كان سهل، كلنا نجحنا.
levantine_sentences.english: The exam was easy, we all passed.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الشغل سهل، بتخلصه بساعة.
levantine_sentences.english: This task is easy, you'll finish it in an hour.

fusha_sentences.arabic: التغيير صعب في البداية لكنه ممكن دائمًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-taghyir sa'b fi al-bidaya lakinahu mumkin da'iman.
fusha_sentences.english: Change is difficult at first but always possible.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المسألة صعبة وتحتاج تركيزًا عاليًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-mas'ala sa'ba wa tahtaj tarkizan 'aliyan.
fusha_sentences.english: The problem is difficult and requires high concentration.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الدرس صعب كتير، ما فهمت منه إشي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-dars sa'b ktir, ma fhimt minno ishi.
levantine_sentences.english: The lesson is very difficult, I didn't understand anything from it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الحياة صعبة بس الله معنا.
levantine_sentences.english: Life is difficult but God is with us.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يذهب إلى العمل سيرًا على الأقدام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yadhabu ila al-'amal sayran 'ala al-aqdaom.
fusha_sentences.english: He goes to work on foot.

fusha_sentences.arabic: قررت أن أذهب إلى الجامعة في الخارج.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Qarrart an adhhaba ila al-jami'a fi al-kharij.
fusha_sentences.english: I decided to go to university abroad.

levantine_sentences.arabic: وين رايح؟ بدك تجي معنا؟
levantine_sentences.english: Where are you going? Do you want to come with us?

levantine_sentences.arabic: رح أروح السوق بعد الظهر.
levantine_sentences.english: I'll go to the market after noon.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يأتي الربيع بعد الشتاء دائمًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'ti al-rabi' ba'da al-shita' da'iman.
fusha_sentences.english: Spring always comes after winter.

fusha_sentences.arabic: هل يمكنك أن تأتي مبكرًا غدًا؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Hal yumkinuka an ta'tiya mubakkiran ghadan?
fusha_sentences.english: Can you come early tomorrow?

levantine_sentences.arabic: تعا هون، في شي بدي أقلك ياه.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ta'a hon, fi shi biddi a'ullak iyyah.
levantine_sentences.english: Come here, there's something I want to tell you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: إيمتى رح تجي زورنا؟ منوحشك.
levantine_sentences.english: When will you come visit us? We miss you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أرى في هذه الخطة فرصة كبيرة للنجاح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ara fi hadhihi al-khutta fursa kabira lil-najah.
fusha_sentences.english: I see in this plan a great opportunity for success.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يرى الأطباء في الوقاية خير من العلاج.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yara al-atibba' fi al-wiqaya khayran min al-'ilaj.
fusha_sentences.english: Doctors see prevention as better than cure.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شفت الفيلم الجديد؟ كيف كان؟
levantine_sentences.english: Did you see the new movie? How was it?

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما شفته من زمان، وين غاب؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma shufto min zaman, ween ghab?
levantine_sentences.english: I haven't seen him in a long time, where has he been?

fusha_sentences.arabic: تعطي الأم أطفالها حبًا بلا حدود.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tu'ti al-umm atfalaha hubban bila hudud.
fusha_sentences.english: A mother gives her children boundless love.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أعطاه الفرصة ليُثبت نفسه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: A'tahu al-fursa li-yuthbita nafsahu.
fusha_sentences.english: He gave him the opportunity to prove himself.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عطيني القلم لو سمحت.
levantine_sentences.english: Give me the pen please.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بعطيك رقمي وتتصل فيي متى ما بدك.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ba'tik raqmi w tattasil fiyyi mata ma baddak.
levantine_sentences.english: I'll give you my number and you can call me whenever you want.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يأخذ العلم من مصادره الأصيلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'khudh al-'ilm min masadrih al-asilah.
fusha_sentences.english: He takes knowledge from its original sources.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تأخذ ما لا يخصك.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La ta'khudh ma la yakhussuk.
fusha_sentences.english: Don't take what doesn't belong to you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: خذ معك مظلة، شكلو رح يشتي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Khudh ma'ak mazalla, shakloh rah yishtii.
levantine_sentences.english: Take an umbrella with you, it looks like it's going to rain.

levantine_sentences.arabic: مين أخذ مفاتيحي من فوق الطاولة؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Miin akhadh mafatihi min foo' il-tawle?
levantine_sentences.english: Who took my keys from on top of the table?

fusha_sentences.arabic: يكتب الصحفي مقالاته بعناية فائقة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yaktub al-sahafi maqalatahu bi-'inaya fa'iqa.
fusha_sentences.english: The journalist writes his articles with great care.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اكتب أفكارك يوميًا في مفكرة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Uktub afkaarak yawmiyan fi mufakkira.
fusha_sentences.english: Write your ideas daily in a notebook.

levantine_sentences.arabic: كتبت الواجب كله باللغة العربية.
levantine_sentences.english: I wrote all the homework in Arabic.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتكتب منيح، الخط تبعك حلو.
levantine_sentences.english: You write nicely, your handwriting is beautiful.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يقرأ كتابًا جديدًا كل أسبوع.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yaqra' kitaban jadidan kull usbu'.
fusha_sentences.english: He reads a new book every week.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اقرأ كثيرًا فالقراءة تُوسّع الأفق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Iqra' kathiran fa al-qira'a tuwassi' al-ufuq.
fusha_sentences.english: Read a lot, for reading broadens the horizon.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتحب تقرأ؟ أنا بحب كتير.
levantine_sentences.english: Do you like to read? I really like it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قرأت الرواية هاي بيوم وليلة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Qara't il-riwaye hay b-yom w leile.
levantine_sentences.english: I read this novel in a day and a night.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ينام الجسم وتظل الروح في يقظة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yanam al-jism wa tazill al-ruh fi yaqza.
fusha_sentences.english: The body sleeps while the soul remains awake.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ينبغي أن ينام الإنسان ثماني ساعات يوميًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yanbaghi an yanam al-insan thamani sa'at yawmiyan.
fusha_sentences.english: A person should sleep eight hours daily.

levantine_sentences.arabic: نمت أمس بدري، كنت تعبان كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Nimt ams badri, kunt ta'ban ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: I slept early yesterday, I was very tired.

levantine_sentences.arabic: كيف نمت البارحة؟ أنا ما نمت منيح.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Kif nimt il-bariha? Ana ma nimt mniih.
levantine_sentences.english: How did you sleep last night? I didn't sleep well.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يمشي ساعة كل يوم للحفاظ على صحته.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yamshi sa'a kull yawm lil-hafaz 'ala sihhatih.
fusha_sentences.english: He walks an hour every day to maintain his health.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المشي في الطبيعة يُريح الأعصاب.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-mashi fi al-tabi'a yurih al-a'sab.
fusha_sentences.english: Walking in nature calms the nerves.

levantine_sentences.arabic: نمشي على البلد ولا نركب سيارة؟
levantine_sentences.english: Shall we walk downtown or take a car?

levantine_sentences.arabic: مشيت من البيت على المدرسة اليوم.
levantine_sentences.english: I walked from home to school today.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يجري الرياضي كل صباح في الحديقة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yajri al-riyadi kull sabah fi al-hadiqa.
fusha_sentences.english: The athlete runs every morning in the park.

fusha_sentences.arabic: جرى بأقصى سرعته ليلحق بالحافلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Jara bi-aqsa sur'atihi li-yilhaq bil-hafila.
fusha_sentences.english: He ran at full speed to catch the bus.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ركضت وراءه بس ما لحقته.
levantine_sentences.english: I ran after him but didn't catch him.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بيركض كل يوم الصبح قبل الشغل.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Byirkud kull yom il-subh qabul il-shughul.
levantine_sentences.english: He runs every morning before work.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يساعد الجيران بعضهم في الأوقات الصعبة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yusa'id al-jiran ba'dahum fi al-awqat al-sa'ba.
fusha_sentences.english: Neighbors help each other in difficult times.

fusha_sentences.arabic: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في حل هذه المسألة؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Hal yumkinuka musa'adati fi hall hadhihi al-mas'ala?
fusha_sentences.english: Can you help me solve this problem?

levantine_sentences.arabic: بتساعدني بالمشروع؟ لحالي ما قادر.
levantine_sentences.english: Will you help me with the project? I can't do it alone.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هو دايمًا جاهز يساعد أي حدا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Huwwe dayiman jahiz yisa'id ayy hada.
levantine_sentences.english: He's always ready to help anyone.

fusha_sentences.arabic: فكّر قبل أن تتكلم، الكلمة لا تُردّ.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Fakkir qabla an tatakallam, al-kalima la turaddu.
fusha_sentences.english: Think before you speak; a word cannot be taken back.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُفكّر المبدع خارج حدود المألوف.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yufakkir al-mubdi' kharij hudud al-ma'luf.
fusha_sentences.english: The creative thinker thinks outside the bounds of the familiar.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لازم تفكر كتير قبل ما تاخذ هاد القرار.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Lazim tfakkir ktir qabul ma takhodh had il-qarar.
levantine_sentences.english: You need to think a lot before making this decision.

levantine_sentences.arabic: شو عم تفكر فيه؟ وجهك مش هون.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Shu 'am tfakkir fih? Wajhak mish hon.
levantine_sentences.english: What are you thinking about? Your mind is elsewhere.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اجلس واسترح قليلًا، أنت مرهق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ijlis wa startih qalilan, anta murhaq.
fusha_sentences.english: Sit and rest a little, you are exhausted.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يجلس الأستاذ أمام طلابه ويشرح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yajlis al-ustaz amam tullabihi wa yashrahu.
fusha_sentences.english: The teacher sits in front of his students and explains.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قعدنا بالحديقة لساعة كاملة.
levantine_sentences.english: We sat in the garden for a full hour.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قعدك، لا توقف هون، الكرسي فاضي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Qu'dak, la twaqif hon, il-kursi fadi.
levantine_sentences.english: Have a seat, don't stand here, the chair is empty.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تنسَ أبدًا من ساعدك في وقت الضيق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La tansa abadan man sa'adaka fi waqt al-dayyq.
fusha_sentences.english: Never forget those who helped you in times of hardship.

fusha_sentences.arabic: نسي موعده المهم بسبب انشغاله.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Nasiya maw'idahu al-muhimm bi-sabab inshighalih.
fusha_sentences.english: He forgot his important appointment due to being busy.

levantine_sentences.arabic: نسيت تلفوني بالبيت، رح أرجع أجيبه.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Nisit telfoni bil-beit, rah arji' ajiibo.
levantine_sentences.english: I forgot my phone at home, I'll go back to get it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما بنسى إياه أبدًا، عمل فيي خير كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma binsa iyyah abadan, 'amal fiyyi khair ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: I'll never forget him, he did a lot of good for me.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتذكر دائمًا كلمات معلمه الحكيمة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatadhakkar da'iman kalimat mu'allimihi al-hakima.
fusha_sentences.english: He always remembers his wise teacher's words.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تذكّر الجيدَ وانسَ السيئَ، حياتك تُصبح أجمل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tadhakkar al-jayyid wa insa al-sayyi', hayatuka tusbih ajmal.
fusha_sentences.english: Remember the good and forget the bad, your life becomes more beautiful.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما بتتذكرني؟ درسنا مع بعض بالمدرسة!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma btitdhakkarni? Darasna ma' ba'd bil-madrasse!
levantine_sentences.english: You don't remember me? We studied together at school!

levantine_sentences.arabic: تذكّرت إنو عندي موعد الساعة خمسة!
levantine_sentences.english: I just remembered that I have an appointment at five!

fusha_sentences.arabic: السفر يُوسّع مدارك الإنسان ويُثري تجربته.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-safar yuwassi' madarik al-insan wa yutri tajrubatahu.
fusha_sentences.english: Travel broadens a person's horizons and enriches their experience.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُسافر كل عام إلى بلد جديد لاكتشافه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yusafir kull 'am ila balad jadid liktishafih.
fusha_sentences.english: He travels every year to a new country to explore it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بدي أسافر هالصيف، مش عارف وين.
levantine_sentences.english: I want to travel this summer, I don't know where.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سافرت كتير بحياتي بس عمان دايمًا بقلبي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Safart ktir b-hayati bass 'Amman dayiman b-qalbi.
levantine_sentences.english: I've traveled a lot in my life but Amman is always in my heart.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اشترى هدية ثمينة لوالدته بمناسبة عيد الأم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ishtara hadiyya thamina li-walidatihi bi-munasabat 'eid al-umm.
fusha_sentences.english: He bought a precious gift for his mother on Mother's Day.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تشتري ما لا تحتاجه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La tashtari ma la tahtajuhu.
fusha_sentences.english: Don't buy what you don't need.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اشتريت تذاكر الحفلة من الموقع.
levantine_sentences.english: I bought concert tickets from the website.

levantine_sentences.arabic: وين بتشتري خضار طازج؟ عندي سوق قريب.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ween btishtiri khudra tazij? 'Indi suq qarib.
levantine_sentences.english: Where do you buy fresh vegetables? I have a nearby market.

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا تتردد في السؤال إن لم تفهم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La tataraddad fi al-su'al in lam tafham.
fusha_sentences.english: Don't hesitate to ask if you don't understand.

fusha_sentences.arabic: سأله عن سر نجاحه فأجاب بابتسامة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Sa'alahu 'an sirr najahibi fa-ajaba bi-ibtisama.
fusha_sentences.english: He asked him about the secret of his success and he answered with a smile.

levantine_sentences.arabic: لو ما بتعرف اسأل، ما في زلمة.
