levantine_sentences.transliteration: Law ma bta'rif is'al, ma fi zallame.
levantine_sentences.english: If you don't know, ask, there's no shame.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سألتو عن السعر وقالي كتير غالي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Sa'alto 'an il-si'r w qal-li ktir ghali.
levantine_sentences.english: I asked him about the price and he told me it's very expensive.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يوم جديد يعني فرصة جديدة للإنجاز.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yawm jadid ya'ni fursa jadida lil-injaz.
fusha_sentences.english: A new day means a new opportunity for achievement.

fusha_sentences.arabic: مرّت الأيام سريعًا دون أن نشعر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Marrat al-ayyam sari'an dun an nush'ir.
fusha_sentences.english: The days passed quickly without us noticing.

levantine_sentences.arabic: يوم حلو إن شاء الله، كيفك؟
levantine_sentences.english: Have a good day God willing, how are you?

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد كان أحسن يوم بحياتي.
levantine_sentences.english: That was the best day of my life.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتألف الأسبوع من سبعة أيام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yata'allaf al-usbu' min sab'at ayyam.
fusha_sentences.english: A week consists of seven days.

fusha_sentences.arabic: كل أسبوع نلتقي لمناقشة التقدم في العمل.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Kull usbu' naltaqi li-munaqashat al-taqaddum fi al-'amal.
fusha_sentences.english: Every week we meet to discuss progress at work.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأسبوع الجاي رح يكون مشغول كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-isbu' il-jay rah ykun mashghul ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: Next week is going to be very busy.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ما شفتك من أسبوع، وين اختفيت؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ma shuftak min isbu', ween ikhtafayt?
levantine_sentences.english: I haven't seen you for a week, where did you disappear?

fusha_sentences.arabic: شهر رمضان المبارك يجمع المسلمين على الصيام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Shahr Ramadan al-mubarak yajma' al-muslimin 'ala al-siyam.
fusha_sentences.english: The blessed month of Ramadan unites Muslims in fasting.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يبدأ العام الدراسي في شهر سبتمبر.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yabda' al-'am al-dirasi fi shahr Sibtambir.
fusha_sentences.english: The academic year begins in the month of September.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الشهر الجاي رح يكون في عيد ميلادي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-shahar il-jay rah ykun fi 'eid miladi.
levantine_sentences.english: Next month will be my birthday.

levantine_sentences.arabic: قبضت مرتبي اليوم، أخيرًا آخر الشهر.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Qabadat murattabi il-yom, akhiran akhir il-shahar.
levantine_sentences.english: I received my salary today, finally it's end of the month.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تمر السنوات سريعًا حين نكون مشغولين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tamurr al-sanawat sari'an hin nakun mashghulin.
fusha_sentences.english: Years pass quickly when we are busy.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُحتفل برأس السنة الجديدة في جميع أنحاء العالم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yuhtafal bi-ra's al-sana al-jadida fi jami' anha' al-'alam.
fusha_sentences.english: New Year is celebrated all over the world.

levantine_sentences.arabic: كل سنة وانت بخير، سنة حلوة عليك!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Kull sane w inta b-khair, sane helwe 'alaik!
levantine_sentences.english: Happy new year to you, may it be a wonderful year for you!

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد البيت بنيناه قبل عشر سنين.
levantine_sentences.english: We built this house ten years ago.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تتكون الساعة من ستين دقيقة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tatakawwan al-sa'a min sittin daqiqa.
fusha_sentences.english: An hour consists of sixty minutes.

fusha_sentences.arabic: في الساعة الأولى من الصباح يكون الذهن صافيًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Fi al-sa'a al-ula min al-sabah yakun al-dhihn safiyan.
fusha_sentences.english: In the first hour of the morning the mind is clear.

levantine_sentences.arabic: انتظرته ساعة كاملة وما جا.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Intazartu sa'a kamle w ma ja.
levantine_sentences.english: I waited for him a full hour and he didn't come.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عندي ساعة فاضية بشوفك فيها.
levantine_sentences.english: I have a free hour, I'll see you during it.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الشارع الرئيسي مزدحم في ساعات الذروة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-shara' al-ra'isi muzdiham fi sa'at al-dhurwa.
fusha_sentences.english: The main street is crowded during rush hours.

fusha_sentences.arabic: نظّف الأطفال الشارع أمام مدرستهم.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Nazzafa al-atfal al-shara' amam madrasatihim.
fusha_sentences.english: The children cleaned the street in front of their school.

levantine_sentences.arabic: عيش بالشارع هاد من عشرين سنة.
levantine_sentences.english: I've been living on this street for twenty years.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الشارع زحمة كتير، روح الطريق الثاني.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-shari' zahme ktir, ruh il-tariq il-thani.
levantine_sentences.english: The street is very congested, take the other road.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يعمل المستشفى على مدار الساعة لخدمة المرضى.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'mal al-mustashfa 'ala madar al-sa'a li-khidmat al-marda.
fusha_sentences.english: The hospital operates around the clock to serve patients.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تبرّع رجل الأعمال لبناء مستشفى جديد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tabarru' rajul al-a'mal li-bina' mustashfa jadid.
fusha_sentences.english: The businessman donated to build a new hospital.

levantine_sentences.arabic: روحو على المستشفى هلأ، الوضع مش كويس.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ruhu 'ala il-mustashfa hala', il-wad' mish kwayyis.
levantine_sentences.english: Go to the hospital now, the situation isn't good.

levantine_sentences.arabic: زرته بالمستشفى وكان أحسن الحمد لله.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Zurtu bil-mustashfa w kan ahsan, il-hamdu lillah.
levantine_sentences.english: I visited him at the hospital and he was better, praise God.

fusha_sentences.arabic: المسجد مكان للعبادة والتأمل والسلام الداخلي.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-masjid makan lil-'ibada wal-ta'ammul wal-salam al-dakhili.
fusha_sentences.english: The mosque is a place for worship, reflection, and inner peace.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يُصلي المسلمون في المسجد خمس مرات يوميًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yusalli al-muslimun fi al-masjid khams marrat yawmiyan.
fusha_sentences.english: Muslims pray in the mosque five times daily.

levantine_sentences.arabic: المسجد الحسيني بوسط البلد معلم مشهور.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-masjid il-Husayni b-wasit il-balad ma'lam mashhur.
levantine_sentences.english: The Husseini Mosque in downtown is a famous landmark.

levantine_sentences.arabic: رحنا على الجامع صلينا الجمعة مع بعض.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ruhna 'ala il-jami' sallaina il-jum'a ma' ba'd.
levantine_sentences.english: We went to the mosque and prayed Friday prayer together.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الجامعة بيئة خصبة للتعلم والنمو.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-jami'a bi'a khasba lil-ta'allum wal-numuw.
fusha_sentences.english: The university is a fertile environment for learning and growth.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تُخرّج الجامعة الأردنية آلاف الطلاب سنويًا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tukhharrij al-Jami'a al-Urdunniyya alaf al-tullab sanawiyyan.
fusha_sentences.english: The University of Jordan graduates thousands of students annually.

levantine_sentences.arabic: بكرا أول يوم بالجامعة، متحمس كتير.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Bukra awwal yom bil-jami'a, mutahammas ktir.
levantine_sentences.english: Tomorrow is the first day at university, I'm very excited.

levantine_sentences.arabic: درست أربع سنين بالجامعة وخرّجت طب.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Darasat arba' snin bil-jami'a w kharrjat tibb.
levantine_sentences.english: She studied four years at university and graduated with medicine.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يعجّ السوق بالباعة والمشترين.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ya'ijj al-suq bil-ba'a wal-mushtarin.
fusha_sentences.english: The market is bustling with sellers and buyers.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تشتهر أسواق البلدة القديمة بتراثها العريق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Tashtahir aswaaq al-balda al-qadima bi-turathiha al-'ariq.
fusha_sentences.english: The old town markets are famous for their deep heritage.

levantine_sentences.arabic: روحنا على سوق وسط البلد اشترينا خضار.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ruhna 'ala suq wasit il-balad ishtareena khudra.
levantine_sentences.english: We went to the downtown market and bought vegetables.

levantine_sentences.arabic: سوق الجمعة فيه كل شي بأسعار منيحة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Suq il-jum'a fih kull shi b-as'ar mnihe.
levantine_sentences.english: The Friday market has everything at good prices.

fusha_sentences.arabic: افتتح مطعم جديد يقدم الأكلات الأردنية التقليدية.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Iftataḥa mat'am jadid yuqaddim al-akalat al-urdunniyya al-taqlidiyya.
fusha_sentences.english: A new restaurant opened serving traditional Jordanian food.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتميز هذا المطعم بجودة طعامه وخدمته.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatamayyaz hadha al-mat'am bi-jawdat ta'amihi wa khidmatih.
fusha_sentences.english: This restaurant is distinguished by the quality of its food and service.

levantine_sentences.arabic: نروح على أي مطعم الليلة؟
levantine_sentences.english: Which restaurant shall we go to tonight?

levantine_sentences.arabic: المطعم هاد مشهور بالمنسف والمقلوبة.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-mat'am had mashhur bil-mansaf w il-maqluba.
levantine_sentences.english: This restaurant is famous for its mansaf and maqluba.

fusha_sentences.arabic: من يعمل الصالحات يجني ثمارها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Man ya'mal al-salihat yajni thamaraha.
fusha_sentences.english: Whoever does good deeds will reap their fruits.

fusha_sentences.arabic: سأل: من قام بهذا العمل الرائع؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Sa'ala: man qama bi-hadha al-'amal al-ra'i'?
fusha_sentences.english: He asked: who did this wonderful work?

levantine_sentences.arabic: مين طق الباب؟ روح شوف.
levantine_sentences.english: Who knocked on the door? Go see.

levantine_sentences.arabic: مين بدو يجي معنا على الرحلة؟
levantine_sentences.english: Who wants to come with us on the trip?

fusha_sentences.arabic: ماذا تريد أن تتعلم في هذا البرنامج؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Madha turid an tata'allam fi hadha al-barnameij?
fusha_sentences.english: What do you want to learn in this program?

fusha_sentences.arabic: ماذا حدث في الاجتماع أمس؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Madha hadatha fi al-ijtima' ams?
fusha_sentences.english: What happened in the meeting yesterday?

levantine_sentences.arabic: شو في آخر أخبار؟ في إشي جديد؟
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Shu fi akhir akhbar? Fi ishi jdid?
levantine_sentences.english: What's the latest news? Is there anything new?

levantine_sentences.arabic: شو بدك تاكل؟ قلي وبعمل إلك.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Shu baddak takul? Qul-li w ba'mul 'ilak.
levantine_sentences.english: What do you want to eat? Tell me and I'll make it for you.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أين تقع مدينة البتراء بالضبط؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ayna taqa' madinat al-Batra bil-dabt?
fusha_sentences.english: Where exactly is the city of Petra located?

fusha_sentences.arabic: لا أعلم أين ذهب منذ الأمس.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: La a'lam ayna dhahaba mundhu al-ams.
fusha_sentences.english: I don't know where he went since yesterday.

levantine_sentences.arabic: وين حطيت مفاتيحي؟ دور معي.
levantine_sentences.english: Where did I put my keys? Help me look.

levantine_sentences.arabic: وين صرت؟ كنا منستناك من ساعة!
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ween sirt? Kunna minstannak min sa'a!
levantine_sentences.english: Where have you been? We've been waiting for you for an hour!

fusha_sentences.arabic: لماذا تأخرت عن موعدنا؟
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Limadha ta'akhkharta 'an maw'idina?
fusha_sentences.english: Why were you late for our appointment?

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتساءل الفيلسوف لماذا نحن هنا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatasa'al al-faylasuf limadha nahnu huna.
fusha_sentences.english: The philosopher asks why we are here.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ليش ما جيت الأمس؟ كنا منستناك.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Leish ma jeet il-ams? Kunna minstannak.
levantine_sentences.english: Why didn't you come yesterday? We were waiting for you.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ليش حزين؟ صار إشي؟
levantine_sentences.english: Why are you sad? Did something happen?

fusha_sentences.arabic: كيف حالك؟ أتمنى أن تكون بخير.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Kayfa halak? Atamanna an takuna bi-khayr.
fusha_sentences.english: How are you? I hope you are well.

fusha_sentences.arabic: يتساءل الجميع كيف وصل إلى هذا النجاح.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Yatasa'al al-jami' kayfa wasala ila hadha al-najah.
fusha_sentences.english: Everyone wonders how he achieved this success.

levantine_sentences.arabic: كيفك؟ كيف الأهل؟ كلهم بخير؟
levantine_sentences.english: How are you? How is the family? Everyone is well?

levantine_sentences.arabic: كيف صرت تحكي عربي هيك منيح؟
levantine_sentences.english: How did you become so good at speaking Arabic?

fusha_sentences.arabic: العمل الجيد يتحدث عن نفسه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'amal al-jayyid yatahaddath 'an nafsihi.
fusha_sentences.english: Good work speaks for itself.

fusha_sentences.arabic: كان جيدًا في الرياضيات منذ صغره.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Kana jayyidan fi al-riyadiyyat mundhu sughurihi.
fusha_sentences.english: He was good at mathematics since childhood.

levantine_sentences.arabic: كيفك؟ كل شي منيح؟ تمام؟
levantine_sentences.english: How are you? Is everything good? Alright?

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل منيح كتير، يسلمو إيديكي.
levantine_sentences.english: The food is very good, bless your hands.

fusha_sentences.arabic: العادات السيئة يصعب التخلص منها.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-'adat al-sayyi'a yas'ub al-takhalllus minha.
fusha_sentences.english: Bad habits are hard to get rid of.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الطقس السيئ أخّر موعد الرحلة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-taqas al-sayyi' akhkhara maw'id al-rihla.
fusha_sentences.english: Bad weather delayed the trip schedule.

levantine_sentences.arabic: الأكل وحش كتير، ما اكلت منو.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Il-akil wahish ktir, ma akalt minno.
levantine_sentences.english: The food was very bad, I didn't eat from it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: مش منيح هيك تتصرف مع الناس.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Mish mniih heik titasarraf ma' il-nas.
levantine_sentences.english: It's not good to behave like this with people.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الجواب الصحيح يحتاج إلى تفكير عميق.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-jawab al-sahih yahtaj ila tafkir 'amiq.
fusha_sentences.english: The right answer requires deep thinking.

fusha_sentences.arabic: تأكد أن المعلومات التي تنقلها صحيحة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ta'akkad anna al-ma'lumat allati tanquluha sahiha.
fusha_sentences.english: Make sure the information you convey is correct.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الكلام صح مية بالمية.
levantine_sentences.english: This is one hundred percent correct.

levantine_sentences.arabic: صح قلت، لازم نفكر قبل ما نحكي.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Sah qult, lazim nfakkir qabul ma nhki.
levantine_sentences.english: You're right, we need to think before we speak.

fusha_sentences.arabic: الاعتراف بالخطأ فضيلة عظيمة.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Al-i'tiraf bil-khata' fadila 'azima.
fusha_sentences.english: Admitting a mistake is a great virtue.

fusha_sentences.arabic: كان قراره خاطئًا لكنه تعلم منه.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Kana qaraaru khat'an lakinahu ta'allama minho.
fusha_sentences.english: His decision was wrong but he learned from it.

levantine_sentences.arabic: هاد الجواب غلط، جرب تاني.
levantine_sentences.english: This answer is wrong, try again.

levantine_sentences.arabic: غلطت وبعرف، بس صعب أعترف.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ghalatat w ba'rif, bass sa'b a'tiref.
levantine_sentences.english: I was wrong and I know it, but it's hard to admit.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ربما يأتي غدًا، لم يُحدد بعد.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Rubbama ya'ti ghadan, lam yuhaddid ba'd.
fusha_sentences.english: Maybe he'll come tomorrow, he hasn't decided yet.

fusha_sentences.arabic: ربما الصمت أحيانًا أبلغ من الكلام.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Rubbama al-samt ahyanan ablag min al-kalam.
fusha_sentences.english: Maybe silence is sometimes more eloquent than words.

levantine_sentences.arabic: يمكن أجي معكم، بس مش متأكد.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Yimkin aji ma'kum, bass mish mita'kkid.
levantine_sentences.english: Maybe I'll come with you, but I'm not sure.

levantine_sentences.arabic: ممكن تكون معه حق، بتعرف.
levantine_sentences.english: Maybe he's right, you know.

fusha_sentences.arabic: أصبح الهاتف الذكي جزءًا لا يتجزأ من حياتنا.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Asbaha al-hatif al-dhaki juz'an la yatajazza' min hayatina.
fusha_sentences.english: The smartphone has become an inseparable part of our lives.

fusha_sentences.arabic: اتصل به عبر الهاتف بمجرد وصوله.
fusha_sentences.transliteration: Ittasala bihi 'abra al-hatif bi-mujarrad wusulihi.
fusha_sentences.english: He called him by phone as soon as he arrived.

levantine_sentences.arabic: تلفوني وقع وانكسرت شاشته.
levantine_sentences.english: My phone fell and its screen broke.

levantine_sentences.arabic: اتصل فيّ لما توصل، ما بعرف الطريق.
levantine_sentences.transliteration: Ittasil fiyyi lamma tusal, ma ba'rif il-tariq.
levantine_sentences.english: Call me when you arrive, I don't know the way.
